data.title: Coalition: Military Operation Carried Out in Sanaa to Target Ballistic Missile, UAV Capabilities
data.content:
Riyadh, November 20, 2026, SPA -- Official Spokesperson of the Coalition to Restore Legitimacy in Yemen Major General Turki Al-Malki stated that a military operation was carried out in Sanaa at dawn today, targeting ballistic missile and UAV capabilities.
    He noted that the military operation focused on destroying and neutralizing sources of threat to prevent attacks against civilians in Yemen and Saudi Arabia.
    -- SPA
17:29 Local Time 14:29 GMT
0054
